text.p: The following are some domestic stories in Portuguese newspapers.
- Representatives of fishing fleet owners petition Prime Minister Antonio Guterres to suspend decree banning fishing at weekends, saying it is ruining some of them.

- President Jorge Sampaio is "irritated" by the quarrel between the opposition social democrats and the ruling Socialist party over local authority financing. Sources close to the president say he believes the country needs a period of political stability in run-up to launch of European single currency.
The Diario Economico was not immediately available.
